title: A股长假收官、港股轻仓交易；隔夜美股创新高但期指转弱，供股稀释风险上升
summary: A股10月7日仍休市、10月8日复市；9月30日AKShare宽度仅作旧基线。港股10月6日恒指与恒科分别收涨1.00%和0.94%，但港股通仍暂停。隔夜美股三大指数创新高，公用事业、CEG和MRVL走强，WDC大跌形成存储链反证；亚洲早盘标普与纳指期指可得延迟指示均约跌0.1%。00370与02147供股认购不足，明确列回避。美股排行未覆盖10月6日现金时段，按0行降级。

复市前夜 美股新高 电力+AI 供股稀释 数据中心芯片 存储分化 南向缺席 油价高位 排行降级 政策托底
利好利空中性
重大新闻汇总
海外
美股三大指数再创新高
10月6日标普500涨0.58%至7818.93点、纳指涨0.45%至27599.79点、道指涨0.49%至51521.28点；公用事业领涨，NYSE上涨股与下跌股约1.93比1，风险偏好改善但小盘罗素2000跌0.59%。
夜盘
亚洲早盘期指略转弱
截至本轮可得延时报价，标普500与纳指期货均约跌0.1%，油价约涨1%；道指期货可靠数值未取得。期指与隔夜现货方向分化，港股开盘不宜直接追高。
地缘
中东供应风险继续托住油价
Reuters称霍尔木兹海峡关闭与地区出口受限仍影响约1400万桶/日供应，紧急储备缓冲接近耗尽；WTI最新可得约89.99美元，能源成本与航运风险仍高。
市场
A股国庆假期最后一日休市
沪深市场10月1日至7日休市、10月8日复市。AKShare最新文件生成于10月6日14:22，但A股实际市场日仍为9月30日：2566涨、2824跌、175平，中位数-0.09%，只作复市前旧基线。
港股
港股周二收涨但缺少南向资金
10月6日恒指收24280.56点、涨1.00%，恒科收4223.08点、涨0.94%；国庆期间港股通暂停至10月7日，今日价格发现仍由离岸资金主导，流动性与广度需开盘后确认。
政策
集成电路增值税加计抵减清单启动
工信部9月30日启动2026年度享受增值税加计抵减政策的集成电路企业清单制定，申报窗口为10月9日至16日；政策方向利好合资格企业，但资格不等于当期利润。
政策
52个制造业项目向民资推介
国家发改委9月29日公开推介52个制造业项目，预计总投资524亿元、拟引入民间资本155亿元，覆盖化工、非金属、金属制品与通用/专用设备；订单兑现仍是后续验证点。
产业
科技强国部署聚焦AI与工业基础
国新办9月29日发布会提出在人工智能、量子科技、生命科学、集成电路和工业母机等领域体系化布局重大任务；长期方向明确，但今日仍需公司级催化与本地价格反馈。
公司
盛美上海在手订单同比增长88.20%
公司此前公告截至9月29日在手订单170.73亿元。A股9月30日收294.28元、跌3.02%，公告在收盘后披露且长假中无公告后成交，继续列条件关注而非已确认多头。
公司
招商轮船25年VLOC长协增强能见度
全资子公司香港明华签署6艘VLOC船舶25年长期运输协议，总金额预计不低于28亿美元；9月30日收20.15元、涨1.31%，但合同在盘后披露，需复市后量价和履约节奏确认。
公司
港仔机器人供股认购率仅19.3%
HKEX公告显示1供2合计10.49亿股，原股东有效接纳及额外申请仅占19.3%，其余80.7%由包销安排引入认购；总股本由约20.98亿股增至31.46亿股，稀释与承接风险显著。
公司
正味集团供股约63.87%未获认购
HKEX公告显示6供1、每股0.4港元的4.032亿股供股中，仅36.13%获有效接纳，2.575亿股进入补偿安排；配售能否完成及稀释后的价格反馈仍不确定。

美股夜盘行情总结

期指
现货创新高，期指约-0.1%
隔夜标普500、纳指和道指分别涨0.58%、0.45%和0.49%；亚洲早盘可得延迟指示显示标普与纳指期指均约跌0.1%，油价约涨1%，道指期指可靠数值未取得。
映射
电力与数据中心芯片获正反馈，存储出现反证
公用事业领涨，CEG因Google长期购电协议涨12.3%，Marvell涨5.8%；但Western Digital跌6.93%。A/H只观察电力基础设施、光通信与数据中心芯片，不能把AI强势外推为存储链全面多头。
排行
双排行快照过期，当前0行
data/us-rankings-latest.json生成于10月6日10:29 CST，对应10月5日美股现金时段，未覆盖最新10月6日交易；行业与概念均不沿用旧行。

盘前结论

A股休市收官，港股以谨慎观察为主。美股新高与电力/AI基础设施强势为港股科技和公用事业提供情绪映射，但亚洲早盘期指略转弱、油价与长债仍高，且港股缺少南向资金。A股明日复市前不把长假期间公司公告包装成已获价格确认；两项高稀释供股明确列回避。

重点个股关注

盛美上海
A.688082
条件关注
事件：在手订单170.73亿元、同比增88.20%，直接对应半导体设备需求。
价格反馈：9月30日收294.28元、跌3.02%；公告在盘后披露，10月1日至7日无A股成交。
确认/失效：10月8日复市后若放量并相对半导体设备板块走强可确认；若高开低走、跌破公告前收盘或交付延迟则失效。
招商轮船
A.601872
条件关注
事件：6艘VLOC、25年运输协议总金额预计不低于28亿美元，增强长期合同能见度。
价格反馈：9月30日收20.15元、涨1.31%；正式公告在盘后，尚无公告后成交确认。
确认/失效：复市后量价强于航运板块且交付与收益节奏清晰可确认；资本开支上升、履约推迟或铁矿石需求转弱则失效。
港仔机器人
H.00370
回避
事件：1供2的10.49亿股供股仅19.3%获原股东有效接纳及额外申请，其余80.7%由包销安排引入认购。
价格反馈：本轮已尝试Investing与ET Net延迟行情，但未取得10月6日可核验收盘价；不以旧价给实时买卖点。
回避依据：总股本约增加50%，极低原股东认购率与新增股份10月8日开始交易带来稀释和承接风险。
正味集团
H.02147
回避
事件：6供1、每股0.4港元的4.032亿股供股仅36.13%获有效接纳，63.87%进入补偿安排。
价格反馈：ET Net页面显示报价资料更新至10月6日16:24，但本轮未返回可核验价格数值；不冒充当前确认。
回避依据：高比例未认购、配售不确定和潜在大幅摊薄构成明确负面反证，待补偿安排完成及价格稳定后再评估。

板块轮动看板

电力/数据中心基础设施CEG上涨12.3%确认AI电力需求；港股同类只作映射观察，需开盘广度和本地价格验证。
半导体设备/光通信Marvell涨5.8%、国内税收政策与盛美订单形成线索；A股仍休市，港股科技以相对强度确认。
存储链Western Digital跌6.93%构成反证，不能因纳指新高而无差别追逐存储概念。
高稀释供股00370与02147原股东认购不足，稀释和新增股份承接风险高于主题催化。

逻辑链

美股公用事业领涨、CEG与MRVL获强正反馈 → AI电力与数据中心基础设施情绪映射港股 → 只在开盘后广度和价格确认时上调。
WDC显著下跌 + 双排行快照过期 → AI内部仍分化且缺少最新横截面 → 不把隔夜指数新高扩展为存储链全面多头。
集成电路政策 + 盛美订单增长 → 半导体设备有基本面线索 → A股10月8日复市后用成交和相对强度验证。
高比例供股未认购 → 稀释与配售承接压力 → 港仔机器人、正味集团明确回避而非包装为融资利好。

风险雷达

利率与油价10年期美债约5.294%、WTI约89.99美元，高估值成长和运输成本仍承压。
长假价格真空A股公司公告尚无公告后交易，10月8日复市可能出现跳空、拥挤与获利回吐。
供股稀释00370与02147认购不足，新股上市或配售安排可能放大价格波动。
数据时效AKShare A股基线停留9月30日，美股排行未覆盖10月6日现金时段，均已降级且未冒充实时。

数据来源与时间点

窗口：2026-10-06 A/H收盘后至2026-10-07 08:38 CST。国内发现源实际尝试金十、财联社/科创板日报，并以证券时报/东方财富交叉；假期窗口未检得改变结论的新增即时条目。政策主源：工信部（9月29日绿色工厂、9月30日集成电路增值税加计抵减清单）、国家发改委（9月29日52个制造业项目）、国新办（9月29日科技强国发布会）。HKEX主源：00370公告2026100601571、02147公告2026100601483。美股与跨资产：Reuters、AP、MarketWatch截至10月6日美股收盘及10月7日亚洲早盘可得延时报价。AKShare schemaVersion=2、v1.18.94，fetchedAt=2026-10-06 14:22:23 CST；A股实际市场日2026-09-30，港股仅为10月6日14:10盘中快照，未替代正式收盘。美股排行fetchedAt=2026-10-06 10:29:47 CST，仅覆盖10月5日现金时段，行业与概念当前均0行。生成时间：2026-10-07 08:38 CST。

Keyword Cloud

Reopening eve US records Power + AI Rights dilution Data-center chips Storage divergence No southbound flow High oil Rankings degraded Policy support
BullishBearishNeutral
Major News
Overseas
US benchmarks set fresh records
On Oct 6 the S&P 500 rose 0.58% to 7,818.93, the Nasdaq gained 0.45% to 27,599.79 and the Dow advanced 0.49% to 51,521.28. Utilities led and NYSE advancers beat decliners about 1.93-to-1, though the Russell 2000 fell 0.59%.
Futures
Asian-hours futures turn slightly lower
The latest delayed indications available to this run showed S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures each down about 0.1%, while oil was up about 1%. A reliable Dow-futures figure was unavailable, so Hong Kong should not simply chase the prior US close.
Geopolitics
Middle East supply risk keeps oil elevated
Reuters said the closure of the Strait of Hormuz and regional constraints still affect roughly 14 million barrels a day of exports, while emergency-stock buffers are nearly exhausted. The latest available WTI quote was about $89.99.
Market
Mainland holiday ends today
Shanghai and Shenzhen are closed Oct 1-7 and reopen Oct 8. The latest AKShare file was generated Oct 6 at 14:22 CST, but its A-share market date remains Sep 30: 2,566 up, 2,824 down, 175 flat and a -0.09% median, usable only as an old baseline.
Hong Kong
Hong Kong closed higher Tuesday without Stock Connect
The Hang Seng closed Oct 6 at 24,280.56, up 1.00%, and the Hang Seng Tech at 4,223.08, up 0.94%. Southbound Stock Connect remains shut through Oct 7, leaving today's price discovery more dependent on offshore flows.
Policy
IC VAT super-deduction list process starts
MIIT began the 2026 application process on Sep 30 for integrated-circuit companies seeking the VAT super-deduction, with applications scheduled for Oct 9-16. Eligibility support does not equal current-period profit.
Policy
52 manufacturing projects opened to private capital
NDRC offered 52 manufacturing projects on Sep 29, with CNY52.4 billion of planned investment and CNY15.5 billion of intended private capital across chemicals, materials, fabricated metals and machinery.
Industry
Technology strategy emphasizes AI and industrial foundations
A Sep 29 State Council Information Office briefing highlighted major tasks in AI, quantum technology, life sciences, integrated circuits and machine tools. The long-run direction is clear, but company catalysts and local price response remain necessary.
Company
ACM Research Shanghai orders rose 88.20%
Previously filed company data put orders on hand at CNY17.073 billion as of Sep 29. The A share closed Sep 30 at CNY294.28, down 3.02%; the disclosure came after the close and there has been no post-announcement trading during the holiday.
Company
China Merchants Energy Shipping signs 25-year VLOC deal
Subsidiary Hong Kong Ming Wah signed 25-year contracts for six VLOCs with total value expected at no less than $2.8 billion. The share closed Sep 30 at CNY20.15, up 1.31%, but the filing was post-close and still needs reopening-day validation.
Company
Hong Kong Robotics rights take-up was only 19.3%
HKEX filings show a 1-for-2 issue of 1.049 billion shares received valid acceptances and excess applications for just 19.3%; underwriting arrangements brought in subscribers for the remaining 80.7%, with shares outstanding rising from about 2.098 billion to 3.146 billion.
Company
Zhengwei Group rights issue was 63.87% unsubscribed
HKEX said only 36.13% of the 403.2 million shares in its 6-for-1 issue at HK$0.40 received valid acceptances, leaving 257.5 million shares for compensatory arrangements. Placement completion and the post-dilution price response remain uncertain.

US Overnight Market Summary

Futures
Cash indexes hit records; futures about -0.1%
The S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow rose 0.58%, 0.45% and 0.49% overnight. Latest delayed Asian-hours indications showed S&P and Nasdaq futures each down about 0.1% and oil up about 1%; a reliable Dow-futures figure was unavailable.
Mapping
Power and data-center chips confirm; storage contradicts
Utilities led, CEG rose 12.3% on Google's long-term power agreement and Marvell gained 5.8%, while Western Digital fell 6.93%. A/H mapping is limited to watching power infrastructure, optical links and data-center chips; AI strength cannot be generalized to all storage names.
Rankings
Both ranking groups are stale: 0 current rows
data/us-rankings-latest.json was generated Oct 6 at 10:29 CST and reflects the Oct 5 US cash session, not the latest Oct 6 session. No old industry or concept rows are reused.

Premarket Conclusion

Mainland markets remain closed; Hong Kong calls for cautious observation.Fresh US highs and strength in power/AI infrastructure provide a sentiment map for Hong Kong technology and utilities, but Asian-hours futures are slightly lower, oil and long yields remain high, and southbound flows are absent. Mainland company filings are not treated as price-confirmed before tomorrow's reopening; the two highly dilutive rights issues are explicit avoids.

Focus Stocks

ACM Research Shanghai
A.688082
Conditional watch
Event: Orders on hand reached CNY17.073 billion, up 88.20%, directly tied to semiconductor-equipment demand.
Price feedback: The share closed Sep 30 at CNY294.28, down 3.02%; the filing was post-close and no A-share trading occurred Oct 1-7.
Confirm/invalidate: Confirm if it reopens with volume and relative strength versus semiconductor equipment; invalidate on a failed gap, a break below the pre-filing close or delivery delays.
China Merchants Energy Shipping
A.601872
Conditional watch
Event: Six VLOCs under 25-year transport contracts worth at least $2.8 billion improve long-term revenue visibility.
Price feedback: The share closed Sep 30 at CNY20.15, up 1.31%, but the formal filing was post-close and lacks post-announcement trading.
Confirm/invalidate: Confirm on reopening-day strength versus shipping and clearer delivery/earnings timing; invalidate if capex, execution or iron-ore demand deteriorates.
Hong Kong Robotics
H.00370
Avoid
Event: Only 19.3% of the 1.049 billion shares in its 1-for-2 rights issue received shareholder acceptances or excess applications; underwriting arrangements brought in subscribers for the remaining 80.7%.
Price feedback: Investing and ET Net delayed pages were attempted, but this run did not obtain a verifiable Oct 6 close; no stale price is used as a live level.
Why avoid: Shares outstanding rise about 50%, and weak shareholder take-up plus new-share trading from Oct 8 create clear dilution and absorption risk.
Zhengwei Group
H.02147
Avoid
Event: Only 36.13% of the 403.2 million shares in its 6-for-1 rights issue at HK$0.40 received valid acceptances; 63.87% enters compensatory arrangements.
Price feedback: ET Net showed quote data updated through Oct 6 at 16:24, but the page did not return a verifiable price value to this run; no current confirmation is claimed.
Why avoid: Low take-up, placement uncertainty and potentially heavy dilution are direct negative evidence until compensatory arrangements finish and price action stabilizes.

Sector Rotation Board

Power/data-center infrastructureCEG's 12.3% gain confirms AI power demand; Hong Kong peers remain mapping watches pending opening breadth and local prices.
Semiconductor equipment/opticsMarvell rose 5.8%, while domestic tax policy and ACM orders add support; mainland is closed and Hong Kong names still need relative-strength confirmation.
StorageWestern Digital's 6.93% drop is a contradiction; Nasdaq records do not justify chasing every storage theme.
Highly dilutive rights issues00370 and 02147 had weak shareholder take-up, leaving dilution and new-share absorption risk above any thematic catalyst.

Logic Chain

Utilities led and CEG/MRVL had strong positive feedback → AI power and data-center infrastructure map into Hong Kong → upgrade only after opening breadth and local price confirmation.
WDC fell sharply and the ranking snapshot is stale → AI remains internally divided and lacks a current cross-section → do not extend record indexes into a broad storage long.
IC policy plus ACM order growth → semiconductor equipment has a fundamental catalyst → validate with turnover and relative strength when A shares reopen Oct 8.
Large portions of rights issues went unsubscribed → dilution and placement absorption pressure → classify Hong Kong Robotics and Zhengwei Group as avoids, not financing positives.

Risk Radar

Rates and oilThe US 10-year near 5.294% and WTI near $89.99 continue to pressure long-duration growth and transport costs.
Holiday price vacuumMainland company filings still lack post-announcement trading; Oct 8 can bring gaps, crowding and profit taking.
Rights dilutionWeak take-up at 00370 and 02147 means new-share listings or placement arrangements can amplify volatility.
Data freshnessThe AKShare A-share baseline remains Sep 30 and US rankings do not cover the Oct 6 cash session; both are explicitly degraded.

Data Sources and Timing

Window: after the Oct 6 A/H close through Oct 7, 2026 08:38 CST.
